title: Identity of varying-coefficient raw pullback
statement: Let $h:Y\to S$ be a scheme map [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] and let $a:Y\to Y$ satisfy $a=1_Y$. Let $w:a;h=h$, $p\in\mathbb N$, and $F$ an abelian etale sheaf [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves] on $Y$. Let $\varphi:a^{-1}F\to F$ agree, after transport along $a=1_Y$, with the canonical inverse-image identity comparison $e_{Y,F}$. For every etale test object $U$ over $S$ and every class $z\in\mathrm{raw}(h,p,F)(U)$ of [lem-sbc-abelian-higher-direct-image-natural-comparison], the explicit raw pullback satisfies $\mathrm{rawPullback}(a,h,h,w,p,F,F,\varphi,U,z)=z$. This is a single-class identity law; it assumes neither an index diagram nor a colimit. Inverse images are those of [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image].

source.place: Canonical cohomology comparison maps in lemma-relative-colimit; Tag 03CB for inverse-image comparisons; explicit five-factor calculation of parent lem-sbc-abelian-raw-pullback-coherence-base proof step 2.

proof.text: Substitute a = 1_Y and use eq_of_heq to replace the coefficient map by upperStarId.hom.app F. Expand the raw five-factor formula. The proved sheaf left unit law upperStarComp_id_left identifies its first factor with single(upperStarId.inv) at the h-pullback of the free sheaf representing U.

Reuse the fully proved private single_hom and plus_single_natIso helpers of Sheaf.AlgebraicGeometry.AbelianHigherDirectImageCoreComp via a proof-only import all. The latter already transports the degreewise natural-isomorphism compatibility through derived localization and the faithful D⁺ inclusion; its proof uses the existing complex_single_natIso and derived_single_natIso helpers there. For the derived identity functor itself, the local proved id_single helper uses mapDerivedCategoryIdIso_factorsh, mapHomotopyCategoryIdIso_hom_app_eq_id, and mapDerivedCategoryFactorsh_hom_app. The quotient comparison maps are identities by Quotient.lift.isLift_hom and Quotient.lift.isLift_inv, and the single-map comparison for Id is identity by componentwise extensionality. Hence the hom component of upperStarIdDerivedPlus at single(X) is the single comparison followed by single(upperStarId.hom.app X). No single-complex compatibility statement is duplicated locally.

Prove compatibility with shifts directly, in the private helper identity_commShift. The complex identity comparison commutes with shifts by degreewise extensionality. Its homotopy comparison is detected after precomposition with the essentially surjective homotopy quotient; its D⁺ homotopy comparison is detected by the faithful inclusion. Precompose the derived identity comparison with the essentially surjective localization Qh of bounded below homotopy complexes. Its characterization is the derived factorization, followed by the termwise natural isomorphism and identity comparison. Each factor commutes with shifts, by the existing proved commutation instances. NatTrans.CommShift.of_whiskerLeft descends this property to D⁺. This proves the shift equation without using the full derivedInverseImageComposition conjunction.

Rewrite the last single-and-coefficient factor using step 2. NatTrans.shift_app_comm from step 3 identifies the last two factors with the derived identity component at the shifted target. Its naturality moves the pulled-back class to the right of the source identity component. Rewrite that component by step 2 and cancel the inverse single comparison with its hom. The remaining single(upperStarId.inv) followed by single(upperStarId.hom) cancels by map_comp and Iso.inv_hom_id_app. The result is z. No nonzero, nonempty or positive-degree hypothesis was used. The fully proved private helper identity_single_shift performs this calculation for any exact endofunctor P equipped with P ≅ Id; the item applies it to the canonical sheaf pullback identity. This avoids unfolding concrete sheaf instances in the structural calculation.

theorem abelianHigherDirectImageRawPullback_identity {S Y : Scheme.{v}}
    (a : Y ⟶ Y) (ha : a = 𝟙 Y) (h : Y ⟶ S) (w : a ≫ h = h) (p : ℕ)
    (F : Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1})
    (φ : ((a)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}]).obj F ⟶ F)
    (hφ : HEq φ ((upperStarId AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} Y).hom.app F))
    (U : S.Etale) (z : (abelianHigherDirectImageRawPresheaf h p F).obj (op U)) :
    abelianHigherDirectImageRawPullback a h h w p F F φ U z = z
